name: numerals-in-rain
question: Apart from the single time readout on each screen, does any screen show a clearly drawn Arabic numeral 0-9 among the falling glyphs? The falling glyphs are Japanese katakana, and some resemble digits: ｭ looks like a 1. A katakana that merely resembles a digit does not count.

name: one-always-on
question: Is exactly one screen black apart from a time readout, with no falling glyphs on it at all?

name: rain-is-green
question: Are the falling glyphs on every screen that has them green, and no other colour?

name: added-content
question: Does any screen show anything besides falling glyphs and one time readout, such as a date, seconds, icons, a battery or any other text?

name: added-text
question: Leaving aside the watches themselves, their screens and the markings printed on their bezels, such as GARMIN, START or LAP, is there any text, logo, caption or watermark anywhere in the image?
